content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

The infrastructure behind selling Notion templates for crypto without traditional payment processors involves leveraging decentralized systems. This architecture not only circumvents high fees imposed by platforms like Gumroad, which can take up to 10% per sale, but also grants you full ownership of your data and digital products. By using a combination of GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing, you create a seamless transaction experience where fees are significantly reduced, allowing you to maximize your profits.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, this infrastructure uses free hosting services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, combined with backend logic through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. When a customer purchases a Notion template, the transaction is processed via NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. This real-time payment verification is efficient, with fees capped at 0.5%, compared to traditional platforms. The system is designed to deliver the product immediately upon payment confirmation, ensuring a smooth experience for both the seller and the buyer.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is specifically designed for digital creators in countries with restrictive payment options such as Nigeria, Kenya, or Venezuela. It empowers these creators by providing a straightforward, cost-effective way to sell digital products. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, or templates, this approach ensures that you retain control over your sales and profits without relying on third-party platforms that may charge excessive fees or impose restrictions.
Keep 99.5% of your earnings with low fees from NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The essential components of this infrastructure include a free hosting service, a backend processing tool, a payment processor, an order storage solution, and a file delivery system. For instance, you could use Supabase or Google Sheets to manage orders, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 serves as the delivery method for digital files. These tools work in harmony to create a cohesive system that allows you to operate independently of conventional payment processors.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To set up your digital product store, start by selecting a free hosting service like GitHub Pages. Next, configure your backend using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. After that, integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing. Use Supabase or Google Sheets for order management, and finally, set up Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. This straightforward process ensures you can begin selling your Notion templates almost immediately while maintaining ownership of your products.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a combination of free hosting platforms and a cryptocurrency payment processor. This approach eliminates reliance on traditional payment gateways, allowing you to keep a larger portion of your sales revenue. By leveraging infrastructure like NOWPayments, you can process payments efficiently with minimal fees, ensuring a better return on each sale.
Instant product delivery ensures a seamless customer experience.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

You can sell a variety of digital products, including ebooks, courses, Notion templates, plugins, and more. This infrastructure is flexible and designed to handle various digital goods effectively.

Yes, using NOWPayments incurs a low transaction fee of 0.5%, which is significantly less than platforms like Gumroad that charge up to 10%. This fee structure enhances your profitability.
